# agent-scratch

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Where an agent session keeps its scratch files: agentScratchDir(owner) — one private directory per session (/tmp/equin-scratch/<conversation or Claude session id>), delivered to an app-launched agent's shell as EQUIN_SCRATCH — and foreignTempPath(path), which says whether an absolute path names a fixed file in a temp directory every session shares (/tmp, /var/tmp) outside that session's own. A leaf with no imports, so the guard (before anything is installed) and the agent launcher read the same rule.
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `conversations/agent-launch`
    - `conversations/runtime-sdk`
    - `framework/tooling/guards`
- Core:
  - Exports (types): `OwnTemp`
  - Exports (values):
    - `agentScratchDir`
    - `foreignTempPath`
    - `SCRATCH_ROOT`
    - `SHARED_TEMP_ROOTS`
